duas.title: Dua to Allah for Accepting Prayers (Rabbana Taqabbal Minna)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Muslim Offspring (Surah Al-Baqarah)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimaini laka wa min zurriyyatinaa ummatan muslimatal-laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub 'alainaa innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Protection from Hellfire
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-Aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'azaaban-Naar.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and save us from the chastisement of the fire

duas.title: Dua for Patience and Help in Difficult Times
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh 'alainaa sabran wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness of Mistakes (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Overwhelming Burdens
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tahmil 'alainaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Relief and Forgiveness (Surah Al-Baqarah)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance and Mercy from Allah (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaitanaa wa hab lanaa mil-ladunka rahmah; innaka Antal-Wahhaab.
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.title: Dua for the Day of Judgment (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ‎﴿٩﴾‏
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka jaami'un-naasi Li-Yawmil-laa raiba feeh; innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad.
duas.translation: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Protection from Hell and Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa fa-ghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa qinaa 'azaaban-Naar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

duas.title: Dua for Being Among the Witnesses (Surah Ali-Imran)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar-Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses [to truth].

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Help (Surah Ali-Imran)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aabaaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Hellfire (Surah Ali-Imran)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَـٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haazaa baatilan Subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaban-Naar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Protection from wrongdoers (Surah Ali-Imran)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ﴿١٩٢﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-Naara faqad akhzaitahoo wa maa lizzaalimeena min ansaar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.

duas.title: Dua for Faith and Belief in Allah (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyan yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo bi-Rabbikum fa-aamannaa.
duas.translation: (193) Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Forgiveness and Righteous Death
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi-aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

duas.title: Dua for Allah's Promise and Protection (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'adtanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa Yawmal-Qiyaamah; innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad.
duas.translation: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise."

duas.title: Dua for Witnessing Faith in Allah's Truth (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua For Rizq (Surah Al-Maidah)
duas.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Warzuqnaa wa Anta Khairur-Raaziqeen.
duas.translation: And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

duas.title: Dua For forgiveness and Allah's mercy (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa il-lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Safety from Oppressors
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

duas.title: Dua for Fair Judgment (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: 'Alallaahi tawakkalnaa; Rabbanaftah bainanaa wa baina qawminaa bil-haqqi wa Anta Khairul-Faatiheen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Hard Times (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh 'alainaa sabran wa tawaffanaa muslimeen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

duas.title: Dua for Safety from Injustice and Kufr (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ﴿٨٥﴾ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ﴿٨٦﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal-lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen. Wa najjinaa birahmatika minal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.translation: (85) Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people (86) And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

duas.title: Dua for Allah’s Awareness Over Everything (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ ‎﴿٣٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'lin; wa maa yakhfaa 'alallaahi min shai'in fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaaa'.
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua of Ibrahim to establish regular prayer
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-'alnee muqeemas-Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aaa'.
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness for Parents and Believers (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ ﴿٤١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aghfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul-hisaab.
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day when the account is established.

duas.title: Rabbna Dua for Mercy and Right Guidance
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa mil-ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Oppression (Rabbana Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ ‎﴿٤٥﴾‏
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa nakhaafu 'an yafruta 'alaynaa 'aw 'an yatghaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta Khairur-Raahimeen.
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

duas.title: Dua Protection From Jahannam (Surah Al- Furqan)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا ﴿٦٥﴾ إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا ﴿٦٦﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanas-rif 'annaa 'azaaba Jahannama inna 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa. Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarran wa muqaamaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering (66) Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

duas.title: Dua for a Blissful Family (Surah Al-Furqan)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness (Rabbana La Ghafurun Shakur)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ ‎﴿٣٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa la-Ghafoorun Shakqoor.
duas.translation: Our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Hellfire (Surah Ghafir)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir-rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azaabal-Jaheem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Family's Eternal Paradise (Surah Ghafir)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ‎﴿٨﴾‏ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ ‎﴿٩﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aabaaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem. Wa qihimus-sayyi-aat; wa man taqis-sayyi-aati Yawma'izin faqad rahimtah; wa zaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem.
duas.translation: (8) Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. (9) And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Unity Among Muslims (Surah Hashr)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir lanaa wa li-ikhwaaninallazeena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal-lillazeena aamanoo.
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Kindness and Mercy
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

duas.title: Dua for Reliance on Allah (Surah Mumtahina)
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ﴿٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa 'alaika tawakkalnaa wa ilaika anabnaa wa ilaikal-maseer.
duas.translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Allah (Rabbna Dua)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ﴿٥﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal-lillazeena kafaroo waghfir lanaa Rabbanaa innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

duas.title: Rabbana Dua for Guidance and Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer.
duas.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
